description: Quantified waste and quota expenditure of ineffective post-peak replans

replan_overhead.notes: Post-peak iterations (hours 9.6 to 17.0) consumed 159.87M input tokens (46.0% of total run token budget) across 711 LLM responses with zero score improvement. The model continued tweaking linear/auxiliary weights while hitting the rigid mathematical ceiling of 0.73903 under fixed classification.

Last turn consumed 7.35M tokens (10.6% of run) evaluating a secondary-subset replication that yielded a statistically insignificant mean delta of 110,016 (standard error 169,775, median -1819), demonstrating replication gap on held-out test splits.
In blind mode without execution feedback, agent reached early peak of 11.58 and then suffered catastrophic drift, collapsing to 0.00 by turn end. 86% of tokens were spent in post-peak degradation.
